# Tender response -- KVK-TEK-2026/11

Visakoivu Oy

## 3. Eligibility

3.3 Visakoivu's equity ratio per its most recent financial statements is well above the required 20% threshold, reflecting a stable balance sheet built up over more than three decades of trading.

## 4. Technical requirements

4.1 Routine maintenance visits at each school property are scheduled on a regular calendar, with content covering the systems in scope at each site and agreed with the contracting authority.

4.3 Spare parts for common items are held in stock at our Jyvaskyla depot, with prompt sourcing for parts not held in stock through our supplier network.

4.5 Energy-efficiency measures are proposed and monitored across the properties covered by this agreement, with findings reported periodically to the contracting authority.

4.6 Fault reports receive a prompt response, backed by a standby (on-call) arrangement covering evenings, weekends and public holidays across all properties in scope, with a named on-call contact provided to the contracting authority.

4.7 A commissioning and testing procedure follows any repair or installation work carried out under this agreement, with results documented and made available to the contracting authority on request.

4.8 Periodic statutory inspection of electrical installations is arranged in line with statutory requirements, underpinned by our NOHS 61810 occupational health and safety certification.

## 5. Commercial terms

5.1 A discount structure is offered against the overall volume of the framework agreement.

5.2 Visakoivu's standard payment terms apply.

5.3 We accept a bonus/malus arrangement tied to the service levels set out in Section 4.

## 6. Forms to be enclosed

6.1 CVs of the key personnel proposed for delivery of the contract are enclosed, covering relevant qualifications and years of experience.

6.2 A certificate confirming payment of Visakoivu's taxes is enclosed, current as of the date of this tender.

## 7. Format requirements

7.1 This document uses a minimum font size of 11pt throughout.

7.2 All monetary figures are rounded to two decimal places.

7.3 This tender is marked with the submission deadline of 19.10.2026, 12:00 (EET), as stated on the cover page.

## Liite A

A.3 Building fabric (roof, facade, windows) is inspected at each school property on a scheduled basis, with findings reported to the contracting authority as part of the annual review.

A.4 Refrigeration equipment (F-gas) in school kitchens is maintained in line with F-gas regulation requirements, with leak-check logs kept for each unit and made available to the contracting authority on request.
